subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/38364 stay open as the umbrella for both structured reply metadata and no-output semantics, or should it be split/closed in favor of the narrower active items?
rationale: Current main has a partial UI quote implementation, but the remaining work crosses protocol, session state, runtime context, and final delivery semantics, so automation should not choose the permanent contract boundary.

options.title: Keep umbrella until contracts land
options.body: Leave this issue open until the structured reply metadata path is resolved through the active PRs and the no-output/fallback half is explicitly handed to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561.

options.title: Split into canonical items now
options.body: Close this issue after linking the reply metadata half to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88032 and the no-output half to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561.

options.title: Close after Markdown-only UI
options.body: Treat the merged Control UI quote feature as sufficient and reject structured reply metadata as out of scope, accepting that runtime/session reply facts remain absent for web chat.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella until contracts land
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until the structured reply metadata path is resolved through the active PRs and the no-output/fallback half is explicitly handed to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice spans gateway protocol, session/runtime context, and product fallback behavior rather than one contributor's local patch.
